column1: # 1001 Books You Must Read Before You Die -- sample
# Format: title<TAB>author. Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored.
# Wikidata does not model this list, so the "1001 Books" seed source reads it
# from disk. This file is a starter sample chosen to cover the range the app
# cares about -- 18th-century canon through contemporary world literature.
# To seed the full list: save it as data/1001-books.tsv (same format) and run
# `npm run seed`. The job is idempotent, so re-running only adds.
# Titles are matched against Open Library and Wikipedia at hydration time, so
